item.title: Amtrak announces 'Adventure Awaits' sale, USA Rail Pass available
item.description: (WTAJ) -- Amtrak will be celebrating America’s 250th birthday with a special sale on its rail pass. The “Adventure Awaits Sale" offers the USA Rail Pass, which is usually priced at $499, for $250 under the sale. item.title: Nurses at UPMC Altoona approve new deal
item.description: ALTOONA, Pa. (WTAJ) — Nurses at UPMC Altoona who are members of the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) voted with 91% approval on a new union contract. item.title: Pennsylvania Property Tax, Rent Rebate Program now accepting applications
item.description: PENNSYLVANIA (WTAJ) — The Property Tax and Rent Rebate Program (PTRR), designed to help older Pennsylvanians and those with disabilities, is now accepting applications for 2025. Applications are now open for rebates on any property taxes or rent paid in 2025. The maximum standard rebate is $1,000, with the income limit now set at $48,110. [...]
